Kinetic sand is a great way to provide sensory input while still working on a multitude of skills.  I love to use cookie cutters in the sand to work on bilateral skills, pressure and and force regulation.  Cutting with sand is a great introduction to snipping and provides additional sensory feedback. Kids who are struggling with writing tend to be more willing to practice writing on different surfaces. Try sand and use a paint brush for smooth lines.  #occupationaltherapy #ot #sensoryactivities #finemotorskills #sensory #schoolbasedot

Artist Rachel Youn creates kinetic sculptures and installations that combine artificial plants, discarded consumer objects and mechanical devices to imitate the movements of living organisms. In Pretty Behavior (2026), Youn modifies a neck massager and connects it to an artificial orchid and leaves using metal hardware, chains and glass. Once activated, the machine makes the flower shake and move continuously, giving the synthetic plant an uncanny appearance of life. Youn frequently repurposes massagers and other machines originally designed to act on the human body, redirecting their repetitive movements into artificial plants. The objects appear to dance, struggle or react despite having no consciousness. #artist #art #niche #weird #avantgarde

Cornstarch + dishwasher = kinetic sand magic ✨ Wait till you feel this texture 😌 #KineticSand #DIYSand #CornstarchDIY #SatisfyingVideo #LiONiLittleToyland                                 🫧 Cornstarch & Dishwasher Kinetic Sand 🛒 Ingredients 1 cup cornstarch 2–3 tbsp dishwasher rinse aid (or liquid dishwasher aid) Food coloring (optional) A few drops water (only if needed) 👩‍🍳 Instructions Add cornstarch Pour cornstarch into a bowl. Mix in dishwasher aid Add 2 tbsp first. Stir slowly with a spoon or hands. Adjust texture If too dry, add a little more dishwasher aid (½ tbsp at a time). Texture should be soft, moldable, and slightly crumbly. Color it (optional) Add 1–2 drops food coloring and mix until evenly colored. Test the sand Squeeze → it holds shape. Let go → it slowly crumbles 😍 Play & film Press, cut, scoop, or mold for satisfying textures. 💡 Tips Add very small amounts of liquid — too much makes it sticky Best texture = not wet, not dusty Use cookie cutters or molds for cute shapes 💖 ⚠️ Safety Note (important) Not edible ❌ Adult supervision recommended Wash hands after play Store in an airtight container, use within 2–3 days
